description: Customer decision deal-note writer (scripts/customer_decision.ts respond / confirm, CD-08): reads and appends notes to the bound tenant's deal records under customer/<tenant>/deals/ only, bound to that tenant (tenant-bound: libs/core/authority.ts TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES). Assumed only for the best-effort deal note that a customer decision switch adds, so the customer-triggered respond path never needs mission_controller. No knowledge, decision ledger, agenda, receipt, invite or other customer/ authority.
